text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, you're making too much of
a fuss. I'm
perfectly fiiine.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Yawn... But since I'm getting sleepy, I think I'll get some rest. Night night! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! The greatest idols made it here
for me
today!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The idol of the dinos, Tyrannosaurus!
And the idol
of the fossils, Ammonite!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming to my tour! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Catch me with your heart! ☆ I'm the top

Umadol! ♪ Running straight through the
Jurassic
to the Cretaceous! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Phew! That was some dream just now...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But I feel really energized for some
reason! ☆ All
right, let's gooo! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Urghhh... Don't tell me I was dragged all
the way
out to the middle of nowhere
just for extra
classes...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm never gonna get home at this rate! I
need to
escape, ASAP!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Gyahhh! The textbooks are chasing after
me?!
Wh-where can I go?! Aaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Phew... It was just a dream! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон seems to have forgotten
the details
of her dream, but she also
looks quite refreshed.

Смарт Фалкон makes a great escape in
her dream,
but it doesn't look like the
experience was very
restful...
